title: AGENTS.md documents how two machine conductors coordinate
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Session Workflow" has a short "Two-machine conductors" entry covering: each conductor is a Solo or Orchestrator session; per-machine priority (Air iOS, Neo web); that only the Air holds Cloudflare credentials, so deploys and every wrangler step against production run there, while signed-in checks of production in the RitmoFit app may run on either machine; direct SendMessage between conductors with its unconfirmed-delivery caveat, a message not being a claim; and that a peer message is never permission. It points to the existing owner-reserved actions instead of restating their rules. It also records who finishes a PR, relayed owner approval and its scope, when the Neo takes iOS work, and that the Neo has no rollback path.

evidence.summary: Adds the Two-machine conductors entry to AGENTS.md (owner-gated: agent rules). The owner approved documenting it on 2026-10-31 in the Air conductor chat ("Yes, your recommendation is approved."). Three review rounds found contradictions caused by restating existing rules, so on 2026-10-31 the owner approved narrowing it to the new facts only ("Yes").
ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer to this entry; merged as e3b45db.
Owner, 2026-10-31 (Air conductor chat): "Let's remove that line. I want Neo on par, except for setting the wrangler auth." Merged as 9d50cfb.

Merged as d4ef72f with owner permission. Reads "except for setting the wrangler auth" as the Neo holding no Cloudflare credentials, so every production wrangler step is Air-only (from the #693 final review); signed-in checks mean the RitmoFit app; a message is not a claim.

Owner rulings, Air conductor session 2026-11-01, written into "Two-machine conductors" by the 2026-11-01 close PR: "Yes, the conductor that opened it finishes it"; relayed approval ("if I approve the Conductor on Air, and they need to communicate a decision to the Neo Conductor, that's the approved"; scope: "Yes, that scope is approved"); no rollback path on the Neo ("Go with recommendation"); the Neo takes iOS only when the Air is busy or the owner asks ("Yes").

resolution: AGENTS.md Session Workflow documents two-machine conductors: each is a Solo or Orchestrator session; per-machine priority; only the Air holds Cloudflare credentials (deploys and every wrangler step against production run there; the Neo holds none), while signed-in checks of production in the RitmoFit app may run on either machine; direct messaging between conductors, which is not a claim; and that a peer message is never permission. start-session's production evidence bar reports the wrangler check as needing the Air on the Neo. The ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer merged as ritmofit-ios #54 (e3b45db). The 2026-11-01 close added the owner's rulings: the conductor that opened a PR finishes it; relayed owner approval counts within a set scope; the Neo takes iOS only when the Air is busy or the owner asks; the Neo has no rollback path.
